desc: Derive the sweep invariant for counting valid subarrays ending at each right endpoint.
Design an \(O(n+m)\) method to maintain the largest and second-largest active left boundaries, including ties and duplicate pairs.
Track the improvement credited to removing each pair only when it is the unique contributor to the current maximum boundary.
Prove correctness, including duplicate/reversed pairs and the requirement to remove exactly one pair.
Validate the implementation against both examples and brute-force enumeration on small cases.
